svg.title: Architecture 2: TiDE trajectory encoder and decoder
svg.desc: Joint encoding of known covariates across 40 steps · Dense and per-step decoding · 9 training epochs

g.text: Architecture 2: TiDE trajectory encoder and decoder
Joint encoding of known covariates across 40 steps · Dense and per-step decoding · 9 training epochs
1. Dynamic covariate projection and time series flattening
• Day-ahead wind forecast and net load
• Load plan deviation and calendar features
Projected skip: Linear(30 → 12); dropout on residual path
Apply the same projection independently to each step
Flatten covariates and concatenate the origin state
• Encode all 40 known covariate rows jointly
The flattened horizon is one global context vector
The encoder can combine signals across delivery steps
2. Dense temporal encoder and global decoder
Combines the origin state with known horizon covariates
• Example: current wind and a later demand peak
Each delivery step receives 48 decoder channels
Gives the decoder a learned position signal
dec_in = Cat([g, cov_p, X_step, state_rep, s_emb], dim=-1)
• Combines global context with local covariates
• Reuses the origin state at each step
Apply the decoder independently at each step
Each step has access to shared and local context
• Single neural model on the challenge validation window
Pointwise TabularResNet MAE on the same window: 42.36
Ordered by construction: q_05 ≤ … ≤ q_50 ≤ … ≤ q_95
Quantile loss: 0.45 × grid pinball + 0.35 × MAE + 0.20 × tail pinball
Inference averages the classifier and quantile CDF estimates
Shapes: X_step [B,40,30] → cov_p [B,40,12] → joint flat input [B,500] → encoder [B,192] → global decoder [B,40,48] → per-step decoder [B,40,128] → output heads
